# Ketapang Indah Hotel Banyuwangi
> 4-Star Beachfront Resort nestled within 6 hectares of lush tropical coconut groves facing the Bali Strait in Banyuwangi, East Java, Indonesia.

## Entity Overview
- Official Entity: Ketapang Indah Hotel (PT Ketapang Indah Hotel)
- Star Rating: 4-Star Resort
- Location: Jl. Gatot Subroto Km. 6, Banyuwangi 68421, East Java, Indonesia
- Coordinates: -8.1565, 114.3941
- Total Area: 6 Hectares (Tropical coconut palm garden & beach frontage)
- Direct Access: Direct beachfront facing Bali Strait and West Bali National Park mountains
- Booking Guarantee: Official Direct Booking with Best Rate Guarantee, Complimentary Daily Breakfast, Welcome Drink, 10% F&B Discount at Marlin Restaurant & Beach Club.

## Room Categories & Specifications
1. Ocean View Suite (75 sqm):
   - Capacity: 2 Adults + 1 Child
   - Bed: 1 Super King Bed (200x200)
   - View: Panoramic Ocean & Bali Strait View
   - Key Features: Private oceanfront balcony, spacious living room, marble bathtub, espresso machine, 55-inch Smart TV.
   - Starting Rate: IDR 1.850.000 / night

2. Cottage Garden View (32 sqm):
   - Capacity: 2 Adults + 1 Child
   - Bed: 1 King Bed or 2 Single Beds
   - View: Tropical Coconut Garden
   - Key Features: Standalone private cottage, private terrace with garden loungers, semi-outdoor stone bathroom, direct lawn access.
   - Starting Rate: IDR 1.150.000 / night

3. Garden Superior Room (25 sqm):
   - Capacity: 2 Adults
   - Bed: 1 King Bed or 2 Twin Beds
   - View: Lush Tropical Garden
   - Key Features: Floor-to-ceiling glass doors, private balcony/terrace, marble flooring, work desk.
   - Starting Rate: IDR 850.000 / night

4. Superior Room (25 sqm):
   - Capacity: 2 Adults
   - Bed: 1 King Bed or 2 Twin Beds
   - View: Partial Garden
   - Key Features: Contemporary minimalist design, cable LED TV, en-suite bathroom with hot shower.
   - Starting Rate: IDR 720.000 / night

5. Standard Room (22 sqm):
   - Capacity: 2 Adults
   - Bed: 1 Queen Bed or 2 Twin Beds
   - View: Courtyard
   - Key Features: Clean transit accommodation, comfortable bedding, air-conditioned, ideal for Mount Ijen midnight tour or Bali ferry transit.
   - Starting Rate: IDR 580.000 / night

## Dining & Venues
- Marlin Restaurant & Beach Club: Oceanfront dining facing Bali Strait. Specializing in grilled fresh seafood, Ayam Betutu Selat Bali, Sambal Tempong, and wood-fired pizza.
- Wahoo Lobby Lounge & Pool Bar: Poolside cocktails, fresh estate coconuts, and authentic Ijen Arabica coffee.

## Resort Amenities & MICE
- Olympic-length lagoon swimming pool with children's pool.
- The Omah Spa (Traditional Javanese & Balinese herbal massage).
- Cengkeh Grand Ballroom (Pillarless ballroom, capacity up to 800 pax).
- Oceanfront Wedding Lawn (Capacity up to 1,000 guests with ocean backdrop).

## Strategic Distances
- Ketapang Ferry Port (Ferry to Bali): 3.2 km (5 minutes)
- Ketapang Train Station (Banyuwangi Baru): 4.0 km (7 minutes)
- Paltuding (Mount Ijen Crater Blue Fire Basecamp): 38 km (60 minutes)
- Banyuwangi International Airport (BWX): 22 km (35 minutes)
- Baluran National Park: 30 km (40 minutes)
